correctness.rationale: I enumerated all 8! assignments from even to odd vertices, retaining exactly the 272 adjacent bijections. A transposition of two assigned odd vertices is legal exactly when both cross-edges are cube edges, which identifies the unique coordinate square and its orientation. Merging component labels over the retained links exhausts all 64 repertoires, agreeing with all eleven frozen rows and JSON component totals. Each orientation has 128 links; the full case is 264 plus eight isolated states. Each single deletion gives 198,32,32 and ten singletons, eight of which were already isolated, so no proper subset can preserve the original mobile component. Coordinate permutations act on repertoires. At two edges the orientation graph is adjacent or disjoint, at three it is a triangle, path or star, and complements check the larger cases; degrees distinguish these classes and all eleven computed signatures are distinct. Positivity of each RK term forces equality along every enabled flip, so one constant per component gives the full kernel.
residual_risks: Covers only coordinate-square flips in Q4, with every square of an enabled orientation present. Positive weights preserve zero-mode multiplicity, not the excited-state spectrum.

The one-deletion split resolves whether any orientation is redundant; the full census gives the exact ways such controls alter fragmentation and positive-weight zero-mode multiplicity.
